items.item_text: Experience in maintaining multiple filing systems, records, and logistical information is required in this position.
Experience maintaining and retrieving information from both digital and hard-copy filing systems.

This position is responsible for the delivery, replenishment, and inventory management of hospital supplies, ensuring materials are accurately distributed, stocked, and available to support patient care. Maintains inventory records, resolves discrepancies, removes outdated products, and provides responsive customer service while supporting departmental operations as needed.
Ability to read and write English well enough to comprehend and convey instructions on invoices, shipping documents, control logs, inventory sheets, and other correspondence.

Knowledge of functions related to hospital supply activities. This includes distribution logistics, proper documentation, weights and units of measure, and policies and procedures related to product dispersal.
Knowledge and use of basic mathematical calculations; addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
Skills for performing accurate calculations of inventory replenishment, weight, units of measure, and package counts.

Ability to safely perform the essential functions of the position, including transporting materials, maneuvering equipment and carts in various work environments, and working in a standing position for extended periods.

Possess interpersonal skills to relate complicated systems and ideas to diverse audience. This includes maintaining professional demeanor to work accurately and quickly under pressure while handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
